claim: Requirement 2 is unmet for a colon heading: slice_heading_index matches group(1).rstrip(':') while the records component names the slice group(1).strip() with no colon strip (legacy.py:219), so `## Slice A:` is slice A to signoff-v2 and slice A: to the records component. Requirement 3 (a heading with no separator reads as today) pulls the other way, so the spec conflicts with itself for this shape.
scenario: A build doc with `## Slice A:` (or `## Slice A: - x`) and a Status line: ledger.card_of(text, 'A') returns ('built', 4) and set_card moves that card, while legacy.parse_document names the slice 'A:' and card_of(text, 'A:') returns (None, None); the card signoff-v2 sets and the records it appends name different slices. The spec, correctness and seams reviewers' probes and the session's own probe all print records name 'A:' against ledger name 'A'.
